const utcIso = (y, m, d) => new Date(Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d)).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
const addDays = (iso, n) => { const [y, m, d] = parts(iso); return utcIso(y, m, d + n); };
const addYears = (iso, n) => { const [y, m, d] = parts(iso); return utcIso(y + n, m, d); };
